task.title: Redispatch owner once after reviewer reopen

scope.owned_layer: Supervisor dispatch identity and deduplication key bounded review-reopen revision for rejected review redispatch without in-progress polling loops
not_changing: Assignment generation semantics and increment behavior
Product runtime deployment and Source Ingestion

behavioral_proof.review_reopen_single_redispatch: A reviewer rejection/reopen advances the bounded review_reopen_revision in ready_dispatch_signature, creating a fresh dispatch identity key that admits exactly one owner redispatch.
behavioral_proof.polling_loop_suppression: Subsequent supervisor ticks while task is in_progress produce the identical signature and key, which matches seen_event_keys and is suppressed under unchanged_cooldown.
behavioral_proof.assignment_generation_preserved: Task assignment generation is not mutated or bumped, eliminating the need for artificial reassignment workarounds.
behavioral_proof.no_retry_loop_or_task_mutation: No queue retry loop, watchdog bypass, or direct task mutation was added; deduplication operates purely over immutable activity events and task properties.
